howling.line: Every single night I hear the big beast howling
stanza: Every single night I hear the big beast howling
Every single night I hear the great beast howling

howling.line: Great ghosts of old wives, and they're howling!
stanza: But I didn't count the fact that I have ghosts in my mind
Stowaways, great ghosts of my life
Great ghosts of old wives, and they're howling!

prowling.line: But there's no such thing as living without their prowling
stanza: I had my hopes about how I would be after sending them off
But there's no such thing as living without their prowling
